faq.title: Questions before you order?
faq.description: Find quick answers about delivery, payment, tracking, returns, sizing and support.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Delivery time depends on the destination and shipping method available during checkout. Tracking details are provided once the order is dispatched.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: Log in to your VeroMek account and open My Orders. Your order status and tracking information will appear there when available.

items.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: The payment methods currently available are shown during checkout. Never send payment details through chat or email.

items.question: Can I return or exchange an item?
items.answer: Return eligibility depends on the item condition and the terms shown in our Returns & Refunds Policy. Contact support before sending anything back.

items.question: How do I choose the correct size?
items.answer: Select a size on the product page before adding the item to your cart. Review the product details and contact support when you need help choosing.

items.question: How can I contact VeroMek?
items.answer: Contact us through WhatsApp at +34 610 982 845, by email at veromek00@proton.me, or through the Contact page.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.intro: How VeroMek prepares, ships and delivers your orders.

cards.title: Processing
cards.text: Orders are normally prepared within 24–48 hours.

cards.title: Tracking
cards.text: Tracking details are shared when available.

cards.title: International delivery
cards.text: Delivery options depend on the destination.

cards.title: Customs
cards.text: Import charges may apply outside the shipping country.

sections.title: 1. Order processing
content: Orders are normally processed within 24–48 business hours after verification.
Processing can take longer during weekends, holidays, promotions or unusually busy periods.
We may contact you if information is missing or additional verification is required.

sections.title: 2. Shipping costs and options
content: Available shipping methods, prices and estimates are displayed during checkout.
Free shipping may be offered when the order reaches the minimum amount shown at checkout.
Promotional shipping offers may be limited by destination, product or campaign period.

sections.title: 3. Delivery estimates
content: Delivery dates are estimates unless expressly guaranteed.
Customs, weather, carrier disruption or an incorrect address may cause delays.
We will assist with carrier delays when possible.

sections.title: 4. Tracking
content: When available, tracking appears in your order details after shipment.
Updates may take up to 48 hours after carrier collection.
Customers should monitor tracking updates and delivery attempts.

sections.title: 5. Address responsibility
content: Provide a complete and accurate delivery address during checkout.
Contact us immediately if you notice an error; changes are not guaranteed after processing begins.
Additional costs caused by an incorrect address may be charged to the customer.

sections.title: 6. Customs and taxes
content: International orders may be subject to duties, import taxes or local fees.
Unless stated otherwise, these charges are not included in product or shipping prices.
The customer is responsible for charges required by the destination country.

sections.title: 7. Missed, lost or damaged delivery
content: Follow carrier instructions after a missed delivery attempt.
Contact us promptly if a parcel is lost or arrives damaged.
Keep packaging, labels and photos because the carrier may require evidence.

refund.title: Returns & Refunds
refund.intro: The conditions and steps for requesting a return, exchange or refund.

cards.title: Contact support
cards.text: Send your order number and reason for the return.

cards.title: Prepare the item
cards.text: Keep it unused, complete and in original packaging.

cards.title: Ship the return
cards.text: Follow the instructions provided by support.

cards.title: Refund review
cards.text: We inspect returned items before approval.

sections.title: 1. Return period
content: You may request a return within 14 calendar days after receiving the order, unless a longer period is required by law or shown on the product page.
The request must be submitted before the return period expires.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility
content: Items must be unused, unworn, unwashed and in resalable condition.
Original packaging, labels, accessories and included gifts must be returned.
A refund may be reduced or refused if the item has lost value through unnecessary handling.

sections.title: 3. Requesting a return
content: Email support@veromek.com with your order number, full name, checkout email and reason.
Do not send a parcel before receiving return instructions.

sections.title: 4. Return shipping
content: For change-of-mind, wrong-size or customer-error returns, shipping is normally paid by the customer.
For confirmed defective, damaged or incorrect products, VeroMek may provide or reimburse reasonable return shipping.

sections.title: 5. Inspection and refunds
content: Returned items are inspected after arrival.
We notify you whether the return is approved, partially approved or rejected.
Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method and processing time depends on the payment provider.

sections.title: 6. Non-returnable items
content: Used, washed, altered, damaged or incomplete products may not be accepted.
Personalised, hygiene-sensitive or final-sale items may be excluded where permitted by law.

sections.title: 7. Consumer rights
content: This policy does not limit mandatory consumer rights that apply in your country.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How VeroMek collects, uses, protects and shares personal information.

cards.title: Data we collect
cards.text: Account, order, contact, device and payment-related records.

cards.title: Why we use it
cards.text: To operate the store, process orders, provide support and prevent fraud.

cards.title: How we protect it
cards.text: Access controls, secure providers and reasonable safeguards.

cards.title: Your choices
cards.text: You may have rights to access, correct or delete personal data.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
content: VeroMek operates this online store and is responsible for the personal information described here.
For privacy requests, contact support@veromek.com.

sections.title: 2. Information collected
content: Account and contact information such as name, email and profile details.
Order, delivery, return and transaction information.
Technical information such as IP address, device, browser, pages visited and approximate location.
Cookie and usage information used to maintain sessions and improve the store.

sections.title: 3. How information is used
content: To create accounts, process orders, provide support and communicate service updates.
To prevent fraud, protect accounts and troubleshoot the website.
To meet legal, tax, accounting and regulatory obligations.
Marketing is sent only where legally permitted and consent has been provided when required.

sections.title: 4. Payments and sharing
content: Payments may be processed by third-party payment providers under their own privacy and security terms.
Necessary information may be shared with hosting, database, delivery, email, analytics and support providers.
We do not sell personal information for money.

sections.title: 5. International transfers and retention
content: Some providers may process information outside your country. Appropriate safeguards are used where required.
Information is kept only as long as reasonably necessary, although transaction records may be retained longer where required by law.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
content: Essential cookies may be used for login, cart, security and core functionality.
Analytics or marketing cookies are used only where legally permitted and, when required, after consent.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
content: Depending on location, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection or portability.
You may withdraw consent where processing is based on consent and may complain to a data-protection authority.

sections.title: 8. Security and children
content: Use a strong password and notify us if you suspect unauthorised account access.
The store is not intended for children who cannot legally enter online purchase agreements.

sections.title: 9. Changes and contact
content: We may update this policy when services, providers or legal requirements change.
The latest version and revision date will appear on this page.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: The rules that apply when you use VeroMek or place an order.

cards.title: Orders
cards.text: Orders are subject to availability, verification and acceptance.

cards.title: Payments
cards.text: Payments must be authorised and may be checked for fraud prevention.

cards.title: Accounts
cards.text: You are responsible for keeping account details secure.

cards.title: Legal terms
cards.text: These terms govern website use and purchases.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
content: By using the website, creating an account or placing an order, you agree to these terms.
You must have the legal capacity required in your country to enter a purchase agreement.

sections.title: 2. Accounts
content: Provide accurate and current information.
Keep your password confidential and notify us about suspected unauthorised access.
Accounts may be suspended for fraud, abuse, unlawful activity or repeated violations.

sections.title: 3. Products and prices
content: We aim to present descriptions, images, colours, prices and availability accurately.
Appearance may vary by device and photography.
We may correct errors, update information or withdraw products.
The price confirmed at checkout applies, except for obvious pricing errors.

sections.title: 4. Orders and payment
content: Submitting an order is an offer to purchase. Confirmation of receipt does not always mean final acceptance.
Orders may be rejected or cancelled for unavailable stock, failed payment, suspected fraud, pricing error or delivery restrictions.
Use only valid and authorised payment methods.

sections.title: 5. Promotions
content: Coupons are subject to expiry dates, minimum order values and usage limits.
Unless stated otherwise, only one coupon may be used per order and coupons have no cash value.

sections.title: 6. Shipping, returns and refunds
content: Shipping is governed by our Shipping Policy.
Returns and refunds are governed by our Returns & Refunds Policy.
Mandatory consumer rights are not limited by these terms.

sections.title: 7. Reviews and intellectual property
content: Submitted content must be honest, relevant and lawful.
Website design, text, graphics, logos and software are protected by intellectual-property laws.
You may not copy, scrape, reverse engineer or commercially exploit the website without permission.

sections.title: 8. Prohibited use and availability
content: Do not use the website for unlawful, fraudulent or harmful activity or attempt unauthorised access.
We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability and may suspend parts of the website for maintenance or security.

sections.title: 9. Liability and disputes
content: Liability is limited to the extent permitted by law and mandatory consumer protections remain unaffected.
Contact us before formal proceedings so we can try to resolve the issue.

sections.title: 10. Changes and contact
content: We may update these terms to reflect legal, technical or business changes.
Questions may be sent to support@veromek.com.
